conclusion: Static-camera periodic stalls align with native cppgc sweeper tasks on the RHI owner. Two-stage RHI notification permits two approximately 5-ms sweep slices between submissions. Priority setImmediate delivery reduces worst-frame stalls while mean FPS stays approximately unchanged.
